releases.name: Liquid sphere
notes: New logo: a round liquid colour sphere (magenta, cyan, blue and lavender) that swirls inside a soft edge, with a white top light and a faint lavender halo.
The colours turn at different speeds on a 5.4-second rhythm; the sphere moves faster while the brief is read aloud and stays still with Reduce Motion.
Matching still sphere for the browser icon, home-screen icon and share card.

releases.name: Soft blob
notes: New logo: a soft, translucent colour blob (blue, aqua and a violet edge) that slowly drifts, reshapes and turns.
No glass rim or flare; it moves faster while the brief is read aloud and stays still with Reduce Motion.
Matching still blob for the browser icon, home-screen icon and share card.

releases.name: Minimal
notes: White background and a quieter, minimal look: thin dividers instead of shadows, one indigo accent and lighter type.
The brief card is now a simple white card with plain counts; the greeting drops its gradient.
Smaller top-story cards and thumbnails; the animated orb stays small in the header.

releases.name: Light orb
notes: New logo: an animated glass orb with a rotating colour swirl, a drifting light ball and a soft lens flare.
A large orb glows on the brief card, and the orb speeds up and pulses while the brief is read aloud.
Static orb for the browser icon, home-screen icon and social card; motion stops when Reduce Motion is on.

releases.name: Modern header
notes: New home header: live Doha date chip, large greeting and a gradient brief card with story counts and Listen controls.
Search button in the top bar opens Explore with the search box focused.
All notifications are bottom toasts that slide up, with a close button, swipe-down to dismiss and pause on hover; news updates stay until closed.
Pinch and double-tap zoom are turned off; use Aa → Font size to enlarge text.
Responsive pass for 320px phones, large phones, landscape and tablets.

releases.name: AI scenes
notes: Stories without a publisher photo now get an AI-generated photorealistic scene (no people, logos or text), labelled “AI-generated · not from the event”.
Scenes come from a fixed table of generic prompts and are reused across days to keep the site small; Pixabay photos remain the backup.
Needs the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secrets; free Cloudflare Workers AI allowance.

releases.name: Reader
notes: Clean white news-app design with an indigo accent, bold geometric type and rounded image cards.
Swipeable top-stories card with page dots, then Global and India story rows with thumbnails.
New reader: image on top, article panel sliding over it, reading-progress ring and Save / Read source bar.
Display card (Aa): brightness, dark reading theme, font size, follow-device theme and four reading colours (white, sepia, graphite, black).
Explore tab with search, source circles and category tabs; Profile tab with topic picker (My topics), settings and version history.
Keeps the daily brief, Boss greeting, refresh, update banner and notifications.
Royalty-free illustrative photos from Pixabay, stored in the repo and labelled “Illustrative”, when a publisher image is not available (needs the PIXABAY_API_KEY secret).

releases.name: Headlines for Boss
notes: Read-aloud now reads only the headlines after a short greeting.
Personalize the Doha-time greeting with Boss.

releases.name: Pearl Glass & Daily Brief
notes: Pearl Glass light design with frosted cards, blue accents and region controls.
Doha-time greeting, accurately dated brief and device read-aloud with pause and stop.
Refresh reloads the interface and latest edition; open pages check for news updates.
Optional OneSignal device push integration; activation requires owner configuration.

releases.name: Clarity
notes: Light is now the default, with an optional remembered dark theme.
A quieter design with warm white surfaces, sage accents, serif headlines and rounded story cards.
Compact introduction and floating navigation; editions open immediately without a loading screen.

releases.name: Editorial
notes: New newspaper-inspired layout with a bold JARVIS masthead, paper backgrounds, fine dividers and a red accent.
Image-first lead stories, compact thumbnail rows and side-by-side Global and India sections on desktop.
Retains dark mode, story sheets, saved stories, filters and archive.
Clarifies editor-verified labels and the curated edition note.

releases.name: Verified 24-hour edition
notes: Rebuild November 2 for the requested rolling 24-hour window with publisher-page verification.
Exclude stale and inaccessible sources; retain rejection reasons.

releases.name: Lounge
notes: Premium lounge design: warm charcoal and champagne-brass palette, Fraunces serif display, glass header and floating tab bar
Full-bleed lead story and ranked story list with thumbnails
Publisher images shown from the source with credit, falling back to the JARVIS cover
Refresh button: checks for a newer edition and shows when the next one is due
Initialising screen with edition boot sequence
About sheet with version history

releases.name: Launch
notes: Daily automated editions at 07:30 Doha with verification gate
Global and India sections, category filters, saved stories, archive
Launch edition No. 001 hand-verified against publishers
